name: AWS Customer Playbook Advisor MCP
description: Provides real-time access to AWS security best practices, incident response playbooks, and preventive security measures from the official AWS Customer Playbook Framework repository. Enables users to query AWS security guidance for services like S3, IAM, EC2, and RDS through natural language.
